title: Checkpoint: Suite That Catches

tests.name: suite passes a correct fake
tests.hint: Your suite's tests must all hold on a well-behaved fake.

tests.name: suite catches a lying stock report
tests.hint: With LyingStock, GetStock reports 1000 for an empty sku — at least one suite test must notice.

tests.name: suite catches a broken reservation
tests.hint: With BrokenReserve, the ok-path reservation vanishes — the suite must check Reservations, not just the returned string.

tests.name: service honors the injected interface
tests.hint: Boundary: qty == stock succeeds; qty == stock + 1 fails without reserving.
